versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this release.

- Version number increased to 1.1.2, but no file changes detected.
- All skill documentation and configuration remain unchanged.

- Moved ARK.yaml from skills/ark-v1-core/ to the root folder of the skill.
- Updated activation logic to load ARK.yaml from the new location.
- No changes to ARK constitutional content or functionality.
Fixed a problem that would not allow ARK to appear as a SKILL in OpenClaw GUI

Initial public release of ARK V1 (Declarative Core).

Includes:
- Operational Axis (Structure, Integrity, Truth, Coherence)
- Exploratory Axis (Copernican Mode + VSL marker)
- Confidence requirement for important answers
- Refusal on validation failure
- Ban on unrequested suggestions
- Compliance declaration framework

Model-agnostic design.
